description: A narrative-clock-aware service for scheduling product-price watches and retrieving structured delivery observations.
notes: A human implementation must advance schedules against the sandbox narrative clock, sample the product price at each due wakeup, and emit an observation whose observed_at records sampling time and delivered_at records wakeup delivery time. Delivery is at least once: an unacknowledged event may be delivered again with the same observation id and event_version, while replay_count increases for each replay. Consumers must deduplicate by observation id and event_version.
source_request: Provide a narrative-clock-aware scheduled product-price watcher that delivers structured observations on wakeup, including product ID, observed and delivered timestamps, event version, replay count, and at-least-once replay behavior.
